topic: Database aggregation error and temporary disk space
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on a database exception (`NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE`) encountered during an aggregating transform, specifically related to insufficient temporary disk space. It was noted that the current `tmp_path` is located on a single, custom disk partition. Someone suggested moving the temporary data path to a separate disk, but it was advised against because this path is used for temporary tables and would be suboptimal. Instead, the issue was attributed not to an excessive volume of temporary data, but rather to logically deleted data that had not yet been physically cleaned up following a previous operation. A policy was mentioned as being implemented for
decisions: The immediate cause of the aggregation failure was determined to be related to cleanup lag after a previous database operation, not simply insufficient temporary disk space.
